description.en:
Sets one participant of the next skill scene from a team member, by parameter ID, with the kit the member wears (CMND_SETUP_SKL_SQ_CHARAM).
When the soccer scene exists, the character is looked up in the team rosters (team 0 or 1; 2 or more searches every team by parameter ID) and its kit is copied: uniform, home or away, goalkeeper outfit, shoes, gloves (goalkeepers only) and shirt number. Otherwise, or if the character is not found, a default kit is written: uniform 1, home, not goalkeeper, shoes 1, no gloves, number 1. The shirt number is written as 0 for uniforms 900 and above.
Side of the skill scene: "ATK" (attacking side) or "DEF" (defending side).
Participant number on that side, starting at 1.
Team slot: 0 = the player's team, 1 = the opponent. 2 or more searches every team.

examples.case: A match scene (real usage, from ev44010070.nut)
